title: Apple earnings recap: Stock tumbles 6% as Tim Cook warns of 'very significant' supply constraints
byline: Steven Tweedie, Ben Shimkus, William Edwards, Max Adams
excerpt: Apple's services, iPad, and China segments all came in below Wall Street's estimates, as did its guidance for the current quarter's revenue growth.

Apple delivered an earnings beat on the top and bottom line for its fiscal third quarter on Thursday, but its stock sank 7% after as CEO Tim Cook warned that its supply was facing "very significant constraints."

Apple's services business, iPad segment, and China sales all came in below Wall Street's estimates. The company's guidance for revenue growth in the current quarter came in below Wall Street's estimates.

The company's all-important iPhone sales came in slightly above estimates, with $109.4 billion for the quarter compared to estimates of $108.85 billion. Earnings per share were $2.02, beating analysts' estimates of $1.89. Mac revenue smashed expectations, coming in at $10.35 billion compared to estimates of $8.62 billion.

This marks CEO Tim Cook's final earnings cycle as CEO, with "product guy" and hardware boss John Ternus taking over on September 1st. Cook will remain on as executive chairman.

Ternus is inheriting the helm as Apple's stock has been the best performer in the elite group of mega-cap tech names this year, up 25%. The company topped a $5 trillion market cap for the first time earlier this week before falling slightly.

But Apple's analyst call made it clear the incoming CEO will face supply chain challenges, an area that has been Cook's specialty.

Apple raised hardware prices in June in a move it said would help offset rising memory costs amid a global shortage. Cook said it was too early to know the impact of the price hikes, which have yet to include the iPhone.

"The primary issue is advanced nodes that we run our SOCs on," Cook said on the analyst call, referencing supply constraints of its system-on-a-chip silicon. "That's the primary supply constraint now, and the the root cause of it is not a regular supply issue. It's a demand forecast issue."

"We've been pulling supply ahead, and at some point, there's a limit to that, and so we've got a quarter that we're going to to be scrambling on the supply side, essentially," Cook said.

Apple's gross margin at the company level for fiscal Q3 was 48.1% adjusted for the tariff refund, compared to 49.3% the prior quarter. Apple's CFO chalked up that decrease mostly to rising memory costs.

"While FX was a factor, really the the main driver was really the memory cost impact," he says. Apple's memory crunch

The tech industry is racing to secure memory chips — and the squeeze is driving up Apple's costs.

AI data centers are consuming enormous quantities of high-end memory, prompting chipmakers to devote more of their production capacity to the booming market. That has tightened supplies and raised prices for the memory and storage chips used in consumer devices such as iPhones, Macs, and iPads.

Tim Cook has likened that upheaval to a "100-year flood."

As those components become more expensive, Apple has begun passing some of the costs on to shoppers — a move the company rarely makes. In late June, Apple raised prices across much of its Mac and iPad lineups, with increases ranging from roughly $100 to more than $1,000 on certain models and configurations.

Apple is scheduled to release the iPhone 18 in September. Analysts predict it will carry higher prices than the current model.

周四，苹果公司第三财季的营收和净利润均超出预期，但在首席执行官蒂姆·库克警告其供应面临“非常严重的限制”后，该公司股价下跌 7%。

苹果的服务业务、iPad 业务和中国销售额均低于华尔街的预期。 该公司本季度收入增长指引低于华尔街的预期。

该公司最重要的 iPhone 销售额略高于预期，该季度销售额为 1094 亿美元，而预期为 1088.5 亿美元。 每股收益为 2.02 美元，超出分析师预期的 1.89 美元。 Mac 的收入超出预期，达到 103.5 亿美元，而预期为 86.2 亿美元。

这标志着首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 作为首席执行官的最后一个财报周期，“产品专家”兼硬件主管约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 将于 9 月 1 日接任。 库克将继续担任执行董事长。

特纳斯将接任掌舵人，因为苹果公司的股票今年在大型科技股的精英群体中表现最好，上涨了 25%。 该公司本周早些时候市值首次突破 5 万亿美元，随后略有下跌。

但苹果的分析师电话会议明确表示，即将上任的首席执行官将面临供应链挑战，而这一直是库克的专长领域。

苹果公司在 6 月份提高了硬件价格，称此举有助于抵消全球内存短缺造成的内存成本上涨。 库克表示，现在判断涨价的影响还为时过早，iPhone 尚未包括在内。

库克在分析师电话会议上表示：“主要问题是我们运行 SOC 的先进节点。”他指的是片上系统芯片的供应限制。 “这是现在主要的供应限制，其根本原因并不是常规的供应问题。 这是一个需求预测问题。”

库克表示：“我们一直在拉动供应，但在某些时候，这是有限度的，所以我们有一个季度的时间，我们将在供应方面陷入困境。”

苹果首席财务官讲述毛利率受到的影响

经关税退款调整后，苹果公司第三财季的公司毛利率为 48.1%，而上一季度为 49.3%。 苹果首席财务官将这一下降主要归因于内存成本的上升。

“虽然外汇是一个因素，但真正的主要驱动因素实际上是内存成本的影响，”他说。 “正如蒂姆之前概述的那样，当我们谈论内存成本的动态时，我们确实看到了一些部分抵消，例如非内存组件成本中库存减少的好处，以及一些有利的组合。”

库克作为首席执行官提出的最后一个盈利问题：在欧盟做什么？

在作为苹果首席执行官的最后一次投资者电话会议上，库克的最后一个问题是关于该公司在全球的计划。 他强调，除非监管发生变化，否则 Siri AI 目前不会进入欧洲。

“如果你看看欧盟，我们正在与欧盟委员会密切合作，”库克说。 “显然，我们的全部愿望是在任何地方同时推出所有内容。 这始终是我们的理念。 我们在欧盟还无法做到这一点，但我们正在与他们密切合作，试图找到让我们能够在那里提供 Siri AI 的东西。”

“我只想重申蒂姆所说的话，”特努斯说。 “这个领域发生的一切给我们带来了很多机会，我们非常专注于我们的计划，对此感到非常兴奋。”

库克在谈到最近 Mac 和 iPad 价格上涨时表示：“现在就对那里发生的情况做出明确的结论还为时过早。” 他表示，苹果公司正在等待供应链和消费者的反应，然后再永久锁定价格变化。
